files.reason: Builds accrual identity buckets and elapsed fractions; applies linear/compounded growth, full-period day-count context, PIK inclusion and strict ex-coupon entitlement.
Validates half-open reporting periods; compensates native-currency sums; computes year ladders/WAL and conditional-survival PV with FIFO funded-principal recovery.
Reads schema-generation command and delegates artifact generation to core; no pricing, probability, schedule or financial selection algorithm.
Resolves coupon/payment coverage, independent window grids, nesting selection, step-up rate groups and fee schedules; rejects conflicting dates and unsupported coverage.
Defines deferred-error behavior, from/until step-window semantics, coupon/payment dispatch and principal-event sign/currency rules.
Implements checked annual/monthly mortality conversion, explicit clamped conversion after inline tests, PSA ramp and ABS depletion formula.
Compiles adjusted/unadjusted anchors, lagged cash dates, contractual stub/reference periods, IMM/CDS overrides and duplicate-payment checks; production code after test-only helper inspected.
Executes all prepared amortization variants against live Decimal principal, with terminal sweeps, explicit excess errors and economic/payment date separation.
Partitions coupon/fee accrual at economic balance changes using last balance on or before start and excludes end-date movements.
Computes fixed and floating balance-segment amounts; resolves term/overnight fixings and fallback; allocates cumulative overnight increments and bounds; emits signed cash/PIK metadata.
Computes opening-balance or integrated-balance drawn/undrawn fees using contractual segment day count and magnitude-ordered checked Decimal products.
Declares emission modules and re-exports their functions; contains no additional branch, default or arithmetic.
Validates compiled coupon economics/accrual, locks term fixing separately from notional, advances overnight state, settles/splits coupons and computes replay accrued amounts.
Declares builder modules and re-exports existing types/kernels; clarifies credit specifications are not consumed by builder without introducing another selection path.
Validates core horizon/event domain, prepares amortization cadence, initializes pre-issue balance history and chooses terminal economic/payment dates.
Compiles lookback/shift/cutoff/leading-carry observation grids and implements atomic incremental weighted-average/product accumulators and daily/period constraints.
Builds enriched periods and reset dates; creates contractual day-count/reference context and partial ACT/365L proration with domain checks.
Orders coupon/PIK/principal/amortization/fee/redemption stages, updates later-draw installments, resolves curve/fixing dependencies and normalizes metadata.
Validates rate controls; applies bounds/spread/gearing, exact-fixing cutoff rules, term reset-date projection and overnight curve/index annualization conversion.
Defines total row ordering, economic balance replay, principal validation, residual normalization, merge/scale semantics, cash filtering and WAL/PV/reporting wrappers.
Selects seven amortization rules and enforces principal/target currency, percentage, date-order and amount domains; hash is ancillary.
Defines split tolerance, fallback index substitution, compounding modes, daily-bound selection and material floating-rate/market preset defaults and validators.
Computes constant/vector/SDA MDR and original-balance cumulative-loss/timing defaults with optional actual survival denominator and model validation.
Sets opening-balance fee default and evaluates inclusive whole-utilization fee tiers with ascending-threshold validation.
In addition to exports, implements month-zero/one vector indexing, final-value continuation and selected-value/whole-vector probability validation.
Dispatches constant/PSA/CMBS lockout/ABS/vector prepayment curves and enforces whole-model versus per-request probability domains.
Selects default initial/final principal exchange and resolves omitted event cash from delta with kind-specific sign conventions.
Selects fixed/term floating facility rates; requires exact fixings on or before valuation, rejects explicit compounding and projects future reset quotes.
Evaluates constant/vector severity recovery with clamping and invalid selected-vector fallback; separately validates full recovery inputs and carries lag metadata.
Defines material tenor/day-count/BDC/calendar/lag/accrual-adjustment presets and short-front default; validates calendar and payment-lag domain.
Normalizes raw observations and materializes inclusive advancing-window fixings with exact-data precedence, conflict tolerance and immutable market merge.
Maps wire program variants/defaults into canonical builder calls and selects separate economic-validation and native-settlement views; parsing itself is support.
Crate lint settings, modules, re-exports and documentation/doctest wrapper only; no additional financial computation.
Packages schema registry/resources and serialized examples through existing public kernels; feature-gated caching/generation does not add financial selection or arithmetic.
Owns mandatory provider residual normalization and cash view; wraps classified/dated rows with zero-notional/first-currency/USD empty defaults.
